caption_L1: This area graph is called Number of available apps in the Apple App Store from 2008 to 2020. The y-axis plots Apps along a linear scale from 0 to 3,000,000. A linear scale of range 2010 to 2020 can be found on the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: The number of Apps available in the Apple store has risen year on year from 2008 to 2020. The number of apps available in the Apple store rose slowly for the first 4 years and then rose significantly year on year from 2012 - 2020. The number of Apps available in the App store doubled between 2014 and 2016. The smallest rise in Apps available was during 2017 - 2018. There are currently over 3 million apps available in the App store.
